title: Dabo Pepper Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew made with dabo, exotic spices, and peppers. This dish is inspired by traditional Ethiopian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Exotic spices
ingredients.notes: use a mix of berbere, cumin, and coriander

ingredients.name: Red pepper
ingredients.notes: use a sweet or hot pepper of your choice

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic; cook until onion is translucent.
Add red pepper; cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add dabo, exotic spices, salt, and black pepper; stir to combine.
Add water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped peppers or herbs.
